svg.title: Resident-state capacity, not the context ceiling, moved the short-request boundary
svg.desc: The left panel shows the highest tested passing concurrency for the same 2K-input and 512-output workload. Lowering only the context ceiling from 256K to 8K leaves the confirmed boundary at eleven. Increasing the Mamba resident-state budget with matching decode graph tiers produces passing steps at sixteen and twenty, followed by a diagnostic 8K maximum of twenty-three. The deployable 12K profile accepts twenty-two. The right panel shows all three 12K C=22 p95 TTFT trials below ten seconds and the mixed C=23 trials.
